verses.t: And it came to be, after the death of Moses the slave of Yahweh, that Yahweh said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' attendant, saying,
"Moses my slave is dead. So now: rise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the sons of Israel.
Every place where the sole of y'all's foot treads, to y'all I have given it, just as I spoke to Moses.

From the wilderness and this Lebanon, and as far as the great river, the river Euphrates — all the land of the Hittites — and as far as the Great Sea, where the sun goes in: that will be y'all's border.
No man will take his stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, I will be with you. I will not let you drop, and I will not leave you.
Be strong and be firm, for you — you will make this people inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.

Only, be strong and be very firm, keeping watch to do according to all the torah that Moses my slave commanded you. Do not turn from it right or left, so that you may act with insight wherever you go.

This scroll of the torah shall not move away from your mouth. You shall murmur it day and night, so that you keep watch to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way succeed, and then you will act with insight.
Have I not commanded you? Be strong and be firm. Do not tremble and do not shatter, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go."
And Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

" Cross through the middle of the camp and command the people, saying: 'Get provisions ready for y'all, for in three more days y'all are crossing this Jordan, to go in to possess the land that Yahweh y'all's God is giving y'all to possess.'"
And to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said, saying,
"Remember the word that Moses the slave of Yahweh commanded y'all, saying: 'Yahweh y'all's God is giving y'all rest, and he will give y'all this land.'

Y'all's wives, y'all's little ones, and y'all's livestock will stay in the land that Moses gave y'all on the far side of the Jordan. But y'all — y'all will cross over in battle array before y'all's brothers, every mighty man of valor, and y'all will help them,

until Yahweh gives y'all's brothers rest as he has y'all, and they too possess the land that Yahweh y'all's God is giving them. Then y'all will turn back to the land of y'all's possession and possess it — the land that Moses the slave of Yahweh gave y'all on the far side of the Jordan, toward the sunrise."
And they answered Joshua, saying, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so we will listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
Any man who rebels against your mouth and does not listen to your words, in all that you command him, will be put to death. Only be strong and be firm."

And Joshua son of Nun sent, from Shittim, two men — spies — quietly, saying, "Go, see the land, and Jericho." And they went, and they came into the house of a woman, a prostitute, and her name was Rahab; and they lay down there.
And it was told to the king of Jericho: "Look — men have come here tonight from the sons of Israel, to dig out the land."
And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who came to you, who came into your house — for it is to dig out all the land that they have come."
And the woman took the two men and hid him. And she said, "Yes — the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
And when the gate was about to shut, in the dark, the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Chase after them, fast — y'all will overtake them."
But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them away among the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.
And the men chased after them on the Jordan road, as far as the fords; and the gate — they shut it just after the chasers had gone out after them.
And they — before they lay down — she went up to them, on the roof.
And she said to the men, "I know that Yahweh has given y'all the land, and that dread of y'all has fallen on us, and that all who live in the land have gone soft before y'all.

For we heard how Yahweh dried up the waters of the Reed Sea before y'all when y'all came out of Egypt, and what y'all did to the two kings of the Amorites on the far side of the Jordan — to Sihon and to Og — whom y'all devoted to destruction.
And we heard, and our heart melted, and no spirit rose any longer in anyone before y'all — because Yahweh, y'all's God, he is God in the skies above and on the earth beneath.
And now, swear to me, please, by Yahweh — since I have done ḥesed with y'all — that y'all too will do ḥesed with my father's house, and give me a sign of truth,
and keep alive my father and my mother, my brothers and my sisters, and all that is theirs, and snatch our beings from death."
And the men said to her, "Our life in place of y'all's, to die — if y'all do not tell this business of ours. And it will be, when Yahweh gives us the land, we will do ḥesed and truth with you."
And she brought them down by a rope through the window — for her house was in the side of the wall, and in the wall she was living.
And she said to them, "To the hill country — go, so the chasers don't run into y'all; and hide there three days, until the chasers have returned, and afterward y'all can go y'all's way."
And the men said to her, " Clear are we of this oath of yours that you made us swear —

look: we are coming into the land. This cord of scarlet thread you will tie in the window you brought us down through; and your father and your mother and your brothers and all your father's house you will gather to yourself, into the house.

And it will be: anyone who goes out of the doors of your house into the street — his blood is on his head, and we are clear; and anyone who is with you in the house — his blood is on our head, if a hand is on him.
And if you tell this business of ours, we will be clear of your oath that you made us swear."
And she said, "As y'all say — so it is." And she sent them off, and they went; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
And they went, and came to the hill country, and stayed there three days, until the chasers returned; and the chasers searched the whole road, and did not find.
And the two men turned back, and came down from the hill country, and crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun, and recounted to him everything that had found them.
And they said to Joshua, "Yahweh has given into our hand all the land; and also, all who live in the land have gone soft before us."
And Joshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the sons of Israel, and they lodged there before they crossed.
And it was, at the end of three days, the officers crossed through the middle of the camp

and commanded the people, saying, “When y'all see the chest of the covenant of Yahweh y'all's God, and the priests, the Levites, carrying it, then y'all shall set out from y'all's place and walk after it.

Only let there be a distance between y'all and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so that y'all may know the way y'all are to walk, for y'all have not crossed on this way yesterday or the day before.”
And Joshua said to the people, “ Set yourselves apart, for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among y'all.”
And Joshua said to the priests, saying, “Lift the chest of the covenant and cross before the people.” And they lifted the chest of the covenant and walked before the people.
And Yahweh said to Joshua, “This day I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, so that they may know that as I was with Moses, I will be with you.
And you, you shall command the priests who carry the chest of the covenant, saying, ‘When y'all come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, in the Jordan y'all shall stand.’”
And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “Come near, here, and hear the words of Yahweh y'all's God.”

And Joshua said, “By this y'all shall know that a living God is among y'all, and that he will dispossess, yes dispossess, from before y'all the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Jebusite.
Look! The chest of the covenant of the Lord of all the land is crossing before y'all into the Jordan.
And now, take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man, one man for each tribe.

And it will be, when the soles of the feet of the priests carrying the chest of Yahweh, Lord of all the land, come to rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, the waters coming down from above, and they will stand, one heap.”
And it was, when the people set out from their tents to cross the Jordan, and the priests carrying the chest of the covenant were before the people,

and when those carrying the chest came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the chest dipped into the edge of the water (and the Jordan is full over all its banks all the days of harvest),

then the waters coming down from above stood. They rose up, one heap, very far off, at Adam, the city beside Zarethan, and those going down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. And the people crossed opposite Jericho.

And the priests carrying the chest of the covenant of Yahweh stood fixed on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, and all Israel was crossing on dry ground, until the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan.
And it was, when the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, that Yahweh said to Joshua, saying,
“Take for yourselves from the people twelve men, one man, one man from each tribe,

and command them, saying, ‘Lift for yourselves from here, from the middle of the Jordan, from the spot where the priests' feet stood fixed, twelve stones, and bring them across with y'all, and lay them down in the lodging place where y'all lodge tonight.’”
And Joshua called the twelve men whom he had fixed on from the sons of Israel, one man, one man from each tribe.

And Joshua said to them, “ Cross before the chest of Yahweh y'all's God into the middle of the Jordan, and lift up for yourselves, each man, one stone on his shoulder, by the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,
so that this may be a sign among y'all. When y'all's children ask tomorrow, saying, ‘What are these stones to y'all?’

then y'all shall say to them that the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the chest of the covenant of Yahweh. When it crossed into the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. And these stones shall be a remembrance for the sons of Israel forever.”

And the sons of Israel did so, as Joshua commanded. They lifted twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh had spoken to Joshua, by the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and they brought them across with them to the lodging place and laid them down there.
And twelve stones Joshua set up in the middle of the Jordan, under the spot where the feet of the priests carrying the chest of the covenant stood, and they have been there to this day.

And the priests carrying the chest were standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and crossed.
And it was, when all the people had finished crossing, then the chest of Yahweh crossed, and the priests, before the people.
And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed arrayed for battle before the sons of Israel, as Moses had spoken to them.
About forty thousand equipped for war crossed before Yahweh for battle, to the plains of Jericho.
On that day Yahweh made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel, and they feared him as they had feared Moses, all the days of his life.
And Yahweh said to Joshua, saying,
“Command the priests carrying the chest of the testimony to come up from the Jordan.”
And Joshua commanded the priests, saying, “Come up from the Jordan.”

And it was, when the priests carrying the chest of the covenant of Yahweh came up from the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were pulled up onto the dry ground, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and went, as yesterday and the day before, over all its banks.
And the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and they camped at Gilgal, at the eastern edge of Jericho.
And these twelve stones which they took from the Jordan, Joshua set up at Gilgal.
And he said to the sons of Israel, saying, “When y'all's children ask their fathers tomorrow, saying, ‘What are these stones?’
then y'all shall let y'all's children know, saying, ‘On dry land Israel crossed this Jordan.’

For Yahweh y'all's God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before y'all until y'all had crossed, just as Yahweh y'all's God did to the Reed Sea, which he dried up from before us until we had crossed,
so that all the peoples of the land may know the hand of Yahweh, that it is strong, so that y'all may fear Yahweh y'all's God all the days.”

And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the sons of Israel until we had crossed, that their heart melted, and there was no spirit left in them before the sons of Israel.
At that time Yahweh said to Joshua, "Make yourself flint knives, and circumcise the sons of Israel again, a second time."
So Joshua made himself flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at the Hill of the Foreskins.
And this is the reason Joshua circumcised: all the people who came out of Egypt, the males, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the way, when they came out of Egypt.
For all the people who came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness on the way, when they came out of Egypt, they had not circumcised.

For forty years the sons of Israel walked in the wilderness, until all the nation, the men of war who came out of Egypt, had come to an end — those who did not listen to the voice of Yahweh, to whom Yahweh swore that he would not let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
And their sons, whom he raised up in their place — them Joshua circumcised, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.
And when all the nation had finished being circumcised, they stayed in their places in the camp until they revived.
And Yahweh said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled the reproach of Egypt from off y'all." So the name of that place is called Gilgal to this day.
And the sons of Israel camped at Gilgal, and they made the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, on the plains of Jericho.
And they ate from the produce of the land on the morrow after the Passover — unleavened cakes and parched grain, on this very day.
And the manna ceased on the morrow, when they ate from the produce of the land; and there was no more manna for the sons of Israel, and they ate from the yield of the land of Canaan in that year.

And it happened, when Joshua was at Jericho, that he lifted his eyes and looked, and look — a man standing opposite him, his sword drawn in his hand. And Joshua went to him and said to him, "Are you for us, or for our adversaries?"
And he said, "No — for I am commander of the army of Yahweh; now I have come." And Joshua fell on his face to the ground and bowed down, and said to him, "What is my lord speaking to his slave?"
And the commander of the army of Yahweh said to Joshua, "Strip your sandal from off your foot, for the place on which you are standing — it is set apart." And Joshua did so.
